summary: Theldurin the Lost sends you to the Undercity of Lordaeron with a sigil for Keeper Bel'dugur. He wants the keeper to mistake you for one of the people he fled, and asks you to find Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: A Book Written Long Ago
sections.body: The tablet has answered much for Theldurin, yet questions remain. Yagyin wrote a digest ages ago, and the people Theldurin fled keep copies in many places. Their most learned study its pages. Theldurin believes its vast knowledge can protect them, so he wants you to bring it back.

sections.title: The Keeper in the Undercity
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur waits in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show the keeper, who is to take you for one of the people he fled. Ask Bel'dugur for the digest.

sections.title: A Word of Caution
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur welcomes you as an eager seeker of the collection. Knowledge, the keeper warns, gives power to the strong but drives the weak mad. After you show the sigil, Bel'dugur urges discretion with such signs. Some doubt their pledge is righteous, while others would see them fail if they knew of it. Those who share the pledge must be careful, watchful, and patient.

faq.q: Who sends you to the Undercity?
aliases: who gives to the undercity for yagyin's digest
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost sends you to find Keeper Bel'dugur and gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to carry.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of the Hammer for?
aliases: why do i need the sigil
faq.answer: Theldurin gives you the Sigil of the Hammer to show Keeper Bel'dugur, so the keeper will take you for one of the people Theldurin fled.
Yagyin's Digest is a book Yagyin wrote ages ago. Theldurin says it holds vast knowledge, studied by the most learned among the people he fled.
Keeper Bel'dugur is in the Undercity of Lordaeron.
Solution to Doom came before this.
